name: Toshiro Umezawa
description: Imprisoned the yuki-onna in a tile and stole part of her power, embedding it in a kanji on his forehead.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu kills Boss Uramon's task force except Toshiro Umezawa, whom he agrees to form the Hyozan Reckoners with.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu killed all the men except Umezawa

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu and Toshi perform a ritual making Kobo part of the hyozan, and send him to Jukai.
timeline.quote: together they performed the ritual which made Kobo part of the hyozan

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kobo is killed by Choryu; Hidetsugu tortures Choryu for months.
timeline.quote: Kobo was killed by the Minamo wizard Choryu

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu vows total revenge for Kobo's death and kills yamabushi who refuse to help him.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu vowed to exact total revenge on anybody responsible for Kobo's death

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu unleashes his oni army on Otawara, and Toshi declares war on him.
timeline.quote: Toshi openly declared a war between the two founding members of the hyozan

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu nearly kills Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs the other.
timeline.quote: Toshi used Hidetsugu's momentary distraction and stabbed his remaining eye.

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos in two, and Hidetsugu asks Toshi to transport him to the oni's honden.
timeline.quote: the oni overlord was almost effortlessly torn in two by O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa meets Kiku on his trek through Takenuma; she takes him to Uramon.
timeline.quote: Toshiro Umezawa met Kiku during his trek through Takenuma when going home from a soratami attack.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi finds Kiku, spends the night with her and seals the curse in a ceramic tile.
timeline.quote: In the morning, she was free of the curse, which Toshi sealed into a ceramic tile for later use.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi stops Kiku from killing Hidetsugu, invoking the hyozan curse on herself, then blinds the ogre.
timeline.quote: thus invoking the hyozan curse upon herself

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi sends Kiku through the shadows back to Numai; her fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: Toshi sent Kiku through the shadows back to Numai.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa steals The Taken One from Eiganjo and performs a ritual to free the spirit, who takes the name Kyodai.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai, meaning "sibling."

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year, O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: It also defeated Hidetsugu's master, the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily.

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "First Manifestation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi, sent with Uramon's hitmen to attack Hidetsugu, convinces the ogre to form the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: The ogre killed all the others, but the kanji mage managed to convince him to form an allegiance that became known as the Hyozan Reckoners

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi accidentally interrupts a parley and defeats two soratami; Chiyo's party then waits at his home.
timeline.quote: The moonfolk tried to kill him, but he defeated them with the help of his kanji magic.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi and Kobo set out for Jukai and defeat minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage at Sokenzan.
timeline.quote: They crossed Sokenzan on their way, and successfully defeated the minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage .

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kobo is killed by Choryu; Toshi rescues Michiko.
timeline.quote: When Toshi awoke, he found Kobo hung between two trees, his lungs filled with water, a victim of the Minamo agent Choryu .

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mochi shows Michiko her birth night; Toshi accepts Night's Reach's blessings and defeats Life's Web, then sends Choryu to Hidetsugu.
timeline.quote: Toshi was able to defeat Life's Web using his kanji magic that had been greatly enhanced by Night's Reach.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pursuers are killed by the yuki-onna; Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the hyozan; the yuki-onna is imprisoned in a tile.
timeline.quote: The yuki-onna was then imprisoned inside a tile.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer turn on Uramon; Toshi steals the Shadow Gate and is united with it by Night's Reach.
timeline.quote: When Uramon ordered Toshi's death, both of the new hyozan turned on their former lord.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi defeats Chiyo and releases the oni-dog, which destroys much of Otawara.
timeline.quote: He fought and defeated Chiyo, then released Hidetsugu's oni-dog from the tile to destroy much of Otawara.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi steals Konda's stone trophy and escapes the hyozan oath with Night's Reach's help.
timeline.quote: With the Myojin of Night's Reach's help, Toshi was able to escape the bonds of the hyozan oath.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi lifts the curse from Kiku, who then agrees to help him.
timeline.quote: Toshi removed the curse, leading to a night of strange passion between the two.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu chokes Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and invokes the oath's wrath.
timeline.quote: Marrow-Gnawer managed to stab the ogre's eye, freeing Toshi and Kiku but invoking the wrath of the oath upon himself.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi stabs Hidetsugu through the remaining eye; the All-Consuming and O-Kagachi clash and Hidetsugu is changed.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu prevailed in the end, but Toshi used his victory gesture to stab him through the remaining eye from a shadow cast by Kiku's body.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi ends Marrow-Gnawer's suffering with an axe.
timeline.quote: The ronin was, however, unable to save Marrow-Gnawer from the curse and so ended the nezumi's suffering with an axe.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi frees the yuki-onna from the kanji binding her.
timeline.quote: Toshi then released the yuki-onna and returned to Jukai.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi escapes with the disk through the shadows against the myojin's wish; the disk punctures her mask, and he loses her blessings and his kanji abilities.
timeline.quote: She fled and Toshi was spat out of the shadows bereft of the myojin's blessings and even his kanji abilities.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko touches the disk, releasing Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
timeline.quote: Together, they destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chiyo stabs Toshi; Night's Reach forgives him and Chiyo is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Once more, Toshi swore his allegiance to her and so Chiyo was destroyed.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi is transported to Dominaria, blinded, and becomes the first of Clan Umezawa.
timeline.quote: As a parting gift, the myojin took his sight, leaving him blind.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One during the chaos.
timeline.quote: He stole the Taken One from the pedestal

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko sends a kanji message to Toshi; Eiganjo has fallen and the soratami are conquering in Takenuma and Jukai.
timeline.quote: Eiganjo has fallen, Takeshi Konda is missing, and the soratami are conquering in the Takenuma and Jukai.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi finds the oni eating Minamo's library and meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment to the Hyozan Reckoners; Toshi refuses and they become enemies.
timeline.quote: knowing they are becoming enemies

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi finds Kiku, sole survivor of her clan, helps control her shadow powers, and recruits Marrow-Gnawer.
timeline.quote: He finds Kiku as the sole survivor of her wizarding clan.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isamaru attacks Toshi at Eiganjo and Toshi teleports him to Jukai.
timeline.quote: he is attacked by Isamaru

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi uses Night's Reach's powers to chase off the Oni of Chaos at Minamo, drawing Hidetsugu's ire as Konda's ghost army attacks.
timeline.quote: Luckily at that moment Konda and his ghost army attack Minamo

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu reveals the oath kills any who kill without drawing blood and chokes Kiku and Toshi; Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu in the eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself.
timeline.quote: he saves Toshi and Kiku by stabbing Hidetsugu in the eyes

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi appears; the Oni of Chaos flees, breaking Hidetsugu's spirit, and Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer.
timeline.quote: Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi is briefly captured by orochi led by Sosuke, and then tormented by dreams from Uyo and Chiyo confronting him with his misdeeds.
timeline.quote: calling him an oath-breaker

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Myojin reveals Toshi is being manipulated; he reclaims the Yuki-Onna's power and freezes Uyo solid, killing her.
timeline.quote: freeze Uyo solid, killing her

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Konda arrives at Jukai and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi; Toshi teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm against her command.
timeline.quote: he teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai; O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads.
timeline.quote: Toshi suggests " Kyodai ", meaning "sibling"

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyodai summons Hidetsugu, now the new chaos oni, who eats Mochi.
timeline.quote: then Hidetsugu eats Mochi

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chiyo mortally wounds Toshi; Night's Reach saves and teleports him to Dominaria, blinding him on Madara.
timeline.quote: She drops off Toshi on Madara and blinds him.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One in Jukai Forest; she takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai and bound her power with Princess Michiko Konda

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa compares a masterless kami to himself.
timeline.quote: He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick.

citation.text: Kami of the Crescent Moon (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reki describes Toshiro as hero of the Kami War or a selfish thief.
timeline.quote: Some called him the hero of the Kami War, others a selfish thief.

citation.text: Memory of Toshiro (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Toshiro disobeys the Myojin of Night's Reach and is blinded and exiled to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: he was blinded and exiled to Dominaria as punishment

citation.text: "Clan Umezawa", section "Toshiro". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro founds Umezawa Manor.
timeline.quote: He founded the Clan’s ancestral home, Umezawa Manor

citation.text: "Clan Umezawa", section "Toshiro". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa steals That Which Was Taken and carries it to safety.
timeline.quote: That Which was Taken was stolen by Toshiro Umezawa and transported to safety

citation.text: "Eiganjo", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa pulls the Yuki-onna back to her original reign just before she kills Godo.
timeline.quote: the Yuki-onna was pulled back to her original reign

citation.text: "Godo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year Michiko Konda, aided by Toshiro Umezawa, frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Lord Konda, ending the war.
timeline.quote: managed to free the kidnapped scion

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War he purges the Okiba-Gang and meets soratami; Toshiro Umezawa disrupts the parley.
timeline.quote: The parley was, however, disrupted by Toshiro Umezawa , and the nezumi fled wounded.

citation.text: "Marrow-Gnawer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi tricks Marrow-Gnawer and Kiku into the Hyozan Reckoners; bound by the oath they help him neutralize Uramon and steal her Shadow Gate.
timeline.quote: Toshi tricked Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into joining the Hyozan Reckoners gang

citation.text: "Marrow-Gnawer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Minamo Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu's eye, saving Kiku and Toshi but invoking the hyozan curse; Toshi ends his suffering with Kiku's ax.
timeline.quote: Toshi granted Marrow-Gnawer the last mercy of ending his suffering with Kiku's ax.

citation.text: "Marrow-Gnawer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: To prolong the war, the Myojin gives the cornered Toshiro Umezawa power to defeat his enemies in exchange for his service.
timeline.quote: she approached Toshiro Umezawa when he was cornered

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi gives That Which Was Taken to Michiko Konda, ending the Kami War.
timeline.quote: gave That Which Was Taken to Michiko Konda

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Night's Reach takes Toshi's eyesight and banishes him to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Night's Reach took away Toshi's eyesight and banished him from Kamigawa

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War, Toshiro Umezawa secretly follows Chiyo to Otawara and reveals himself; she attacks him in rage.
timeline.quote: Toshiro Umezawa secretly followed the soratami prophet Chiyo to the streets of Otawara

citation.text: "Otawara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro cracks Chiyo's nose, summons Hidetsugu's oni hound to Otawara, and escapes through the Shadow Gate.
timeline.quote: Toshi cracked her nose

citation.text: "Otawara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko, aged 20, sneaks from Eiganjo and is taken from Sugi Hayashi by Toshiro Umezawa.
timeline.quote: but Michiko was taken away by the rogue Toshiro Umezawa

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi uses the yuki-onna to get rid of Uramon's men pursuing him.
timeline.quote: The yuki-onna was used by Toshiro Umezawa to get rid of Uramon 's men led by Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi imprisons the yuki-onna in a ceramic tile and embeds part of her power in a kanji on his forehead.
timeline.quote: Toshi imprisoned the yuki-onna in a ceramic tile and stole part of her power

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi gives the tile to Hidetsugu, who hands it to Godo; Godo releases the yuki-onna in Sokenzan.
timeline.quote: Godo released the yuki-onna in his territory of Sokenzan.

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Forced by the soratami's revenge, Toshi reverses the spell, kills Uyo with her power and frees the yuki-onna to her original realm.
timeline.quote: Then, he broke the final kanji, and the yuki-onna was reinstated in her original realm again.

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
